name: cortico-world-mail
description: Cortico World：邮箱 —— 用 QQ 邮箱的 IMAP/SMTP 读写邮件，读到的邮件落进本地知识库、新邮件摘要进对话；默认 demo 模式内置演示邮箱，不填任何凭据也能装、能看、能发；零第三方依赖。

zh.description: 她能读写你的邮箱：列邮件、读正文、搜索、发信、回信。读到的邮件落进本地知识库（Markdown + JSONL，人读可审计），新邮件摘要进对话。默认 demo 模式内置演示邮箱，不联网、不需要任何凭据；live 模式用你自己填的 QQ 邮箱授权码连接，发信必须经你确认。

en.description: She reads and writes your mailbox: listing, reading, searching, sending and replying to mail. What she reads lands in a local knowledge base (Markdown + JSONL, auditable by a human), and new-mail digests go into the conversation. The default demo mode ships a built-in demo mailbox that never goes online and needs no credentials; live mode signs in to QQ Mail with the authorization code you provide, and sending always requires your confirmation.
